description.ja: 『宇宙戦艦ヤマト2202 愛の戦士たち』より宇宙戦艦ヤマトが最終決戦仕様で立体化！
description.en: Space Battleship Yamato from "Space Battleship Yamato 2202 Warriors of Love" is now three-dimensional with final battle specifications!

description.ja: • 主砲塔や甲板、改良された砲煩兵器など新規金型により最終決戦の宇宙戦艦ヤマトを設定イメージで再現！
description.en: • The final battle of Space Battleship Yamato is recreated in the image of the final battle using new molds such as the main turret, deck, and improved artillery weapons!

description.ja: • 通常版と最終決戦仕様を選択式で再現可能。
description.en: • Regular version and final battle specification can be selectively reproduced.

description.ja: • 専用台座、アクションベース１に対応した艦底部などが付属。
description.en: • A special pedestal and a bottom part compatible with Action Base 1 are included.

description.ja: • 艦橋、艦首波動砲、波動エンジンは、別売りのLEDに対応。
description.en: • The bridge, bow wave cannon, and wave engine are compatible with LEDs (sold separately).
